newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S SAFMARINE TO VISIT CHINA.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S SAFMARINE TO VISIT CHINA.

text.p: South African shipping line Safmarine will send a delegation to China in March to probe trade opportunities and conduct other business, a statement said on Friday.

The team, including representatives of Safmarine and CMBT Lines (SCL), would also review progress on establishing a representative office in China, develop container logistics facilities, and look at the long-term possibility of direct vessel port calls, the statement said.

"Since we opened our China desk six months ago business has been brisk and there have been many inquiries, not only for trade between southern African and China but also between China and West Africa and east coast South America," the statement said.
